items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I was playing with Kid Clayton band when I left Kid Clayton band.

ctx.x: And the little band. You played the band before Henry Harden. Kid Clayton. Yeah, because you was playing some saxophones and you was playing Henry Harden.
Kid Clayton. I was playing with Kid Clayton band when I left Kid Clayton band. I think I went with you all.
